reply_text:
The breakout panels exist but are on a separate page with no link from the main one. I'm adding the link to the 10-01 page's own template (the 09-21 page is unaffected).㊥ (one figure, no breakouts) The per-stage breakout panels exist, but on their own page, and the main page never linked to it. That's why you saw only one figure. They're here: https://zone.hyperreal.enterprises/wip/audits/minard-families-2026-10-01.html. That page has eight panels, one each for perceive, believe, evaluate, select, act, assurance, coordination and none. Each splits its stage into pattern families.

㊢ (what I changed) The main 10-01 page now has a line just under the big figure that links to the breakout page. I rebuilt the page from its own template and republished it. The live copy has the link now. The 09-21 page has its own template, so it's untouched. I rebuilt it and it's byte-identical to before. Committed as futon0 `5f44ee2`.

㊩ (what I haven't seen) The breakout page's panels are drawn by its script when the page loads. Here I can only check that the script parses and that the data has all eight stages; I can't watch it draw. So if the families page also looks empty to you, tell me and I'll dig into it.

🈯 (one page or two) Would you rather the eight panels sit directly under the main figure on the same page, not one click away? It's a moderate job: the two pages have separate scripts and styles that would need merging.
